degree_rationale: Faces appearing from the heavenly prosopon — agape and fear — manifesting from heavens out of the powers' two faces over the small soul. Illumines the natural face-of-God duality.
direction_rationale: Wisdom illumines how heaven's two faces appear naturally to the human soul — bright phenomenology of love-and-fear.
grand_man_function: Natural face-manifestation — the two faces of heaven shown to soul.
title: Faces appearing from the heavenly prosopon (good and bad)
